seo.description: Portfolio of Jigisha Bhatnagar, a B2B sales professional focused on SaaS growth, strategic account management, pipeline generation and customer retention.

seo.author: Jigisha Bhatnagar

paragraphs: I am a results-driven sales professional based in Bengaluru with 4 years of experience navigating complex B2B sales cycles across enterprise and startup ecosystems. My strengths sit across CRM, key account management, customer retention, customer engagement and growth.

At Amazon, I have worked across sales, account management and growth for high-value sellers in India. I have acquired and expanded 80+ strategic accounts, deepened catalog presence by 10,000+ listings, unblocked 500+ listings and influenced 90M+ in GMS through consultative partner engagement and value-based solution selling.

Before Amazon, I managed international key accounts at WorldRef across Indonesia, the Philippines, Africa and KSA, supporting RFQs, commercial quotations, export documentation, procurement coordination and cross-functional deal execution.

items.name: Global Key Account and Trade Sales
description: Managed key accounts across Indonesia, the Philippines, Africa and KSA, handling RFQs, competitive quotations and timely submissions.
